assumptions: No test suite exists anywhere in the repo (probe-verified for the tracked tree); the retry-flag-parity E2E named as precedent in the brief is absent, so the suite was created fresh from ADR-0005's doctrine rather than matched to existing bytes.
stdlib unittest is the acceptable test framework, since the repo declares no third-party dependencies and ships no runner config.
judgment_calls: Sanity gate widened in place in main() via `args.command in ("pack", "handoff")` rather than moved into the command functions — keeps one check, one message, and fires before every per-command pre-flight.

Sandbox harness (make_install/make_repo/run_bale) lives inside the test module rather than a separate tests/harness.py — one consumer today; extraction proposed in notes.md for when a second suite lands.
validation.sh sets TMPDIR under .validation-logs/ so the E2E's temp sandboxes stay inside staging, honoring TARBALL.md section 9's no-writes-outside-staging rule to the letter.
Message parity with pack's refusal is asserted byte-for-byte in the test (single '[bale] error:' line compared across commands), not just by substring.
includes_missing: the retry-flag-parity hermetic E2E test file the brief names as precedent (probe established it does not exist in the tracked tree — a brief/repo discrepancy rather than a packing gap)
